title: bench_pool.record_of prices a run with no observed model without the run's Claude Code version
goal: bench_pool.record_of takes the run's Claude Code version and passes it to run_tokens, so an alias arm whose transcript names no model is priced at the alias model of that version, not the alias's first model.

run: import sys,inspect; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bench_pool; assert "cc" in inspect.signature(bench_pool.record_of).parameters
